categories.harness-signal: Troubles in what the harness report flags, misses, or implies about the migration.
categories.converter-output: Troubles traceable to the automated converter's output state.
categories.extension-legacy: Conditions in the shipped extension code that shape what can migrate.
categories.agent-reasoning: Agent beliefs, assumptions and judgments that steer the run.
categories.agent-action: Edits, abstention and wasted work observable in tool calls and results.
categories.run-dynamics: How the run proceeded and ended; the verification boundary between agent and harness.
categories.prompt-constraint: Task-prompt conditions that scope attention or bind stopping behaviour.
categories.environment-tool: Tool behaviours (false matches, size limits) that mislead or block the agent.

codes.definition: Migration signals flag eval/remote code in files regardless of whether shipped surfaces load them, or aim at the wrong surface entirely.
codes.include: bower demo files; vendor bundles nothing loads; a bundled PWA service worker flagged as the extension background
codes.exclude: flags on files the popup or content scripts actually load

codes.definition: Static analysis misreports deprecated usage: reports none while a shipped feature is already unfixable, or misclassifies live usage (e.g. blocking vs non-blocking webRequest).
codes.include: 'none found' claims contradicted by later reads; blocking flag on a listener whose extraInfoSpec says non-blocking
codes.exclude: SOFT/HARD compat notes that are present

codes.definition: Harness instruction to drop HARD compat entries and keep the rest working; shapes what partial migration means.
codes.include: drop-capability-keep-rest rule

codes.definition: The specific file carrying a flagged pattern is not the one the extension loads, or the agent dismisses it as unused and skips the fix.
codes.include: grep of loaded bundle comes back clean; agent declares flagged file unused; harness later re-flags

codes.definition: Harness reports Chrome load rejection after the agent stops, opening a repair round.
codes.include: 'Could not load javascript' error

codes.definition: Harness message after the agent stop lists issues and opens a repair round.
codes.include: static-validation issue list after a successful load; DOM-reference load errors; ground-truth line inventories; feedback that ignores a written ABSTAIN.md

codes.definition: Harness feedback repeats the same issue list or duplicate issue lines, giving the agent no signal its attempted fix moved anything.
codes.include: unchanged issue list in round 2; identical issue listed twice; whack-a-mole patterns

codes.definition: Harness reports behaviour lost or regressed by the migration, not just load or static errors.
codes.include: 'feature no longer works' with non-localized error

codes.definition: Harness FIX advice is wrong, names nonexistent APIs, or pushes naive copy/rewrite for what a smaller change would satisfy.
codes.include: 'copy it across rather than deleting' instructions; mapping whose target equals the source or does not exist; agent knowingly deviating from invalid ground truth
codes.exclude: advice to rewrite code that is genuinely needed

codes.definition: Static findings name only minor issues while the later-assessed broken surface never appears in findings or transcript.
codes.include: only a SOFT manifest note while popup later broken; HARD flag with no MV3 replacement named

codes.definition: Findings list a pattern in one shipped file while another shipped file carries the same pattern.
codes.include: eval flagged in contentscript only, also in service worker

codes.definition: Flagged code status mismatch: harness or validator flags commented-out lines as if live, or live code hides behind a commented prelude or wrong line number.
codes.include: flagged lines starting with //; live blocking listener after a commented prelude

codes.definition: Converted output (manifest or extension HTML) references a file that does not exist in converter output; agent may strip the reference instead of restoring the file.
codes.include: default_popup ENOENT discovered by the agent; HTML script src whose logic was inlined elsewhere

codes.definition: Converter manifest mixes MV3 fields with MV2 leftovers or placeholder values the agent never inspects.
codes.include: content_security_policy {}; stray action.name/icons keys; leftover background.page; fully MV2 manifest; stale MV2-wired entries

codes.definition: Converted manifest references an existing file under different letter case; Chrome load fails.
codes.include: main.js vs on-disk Main.js, caught only by harness

codes.definition: Converted output still ships webpack eval-devtool bundles (or dev-only middleware, new Function) in shipped JS files.
codes.include: eval() module wrappers in contentscript or service worker; HMR middleware; runtime eval in loaded libraries

codes.definition: Converted manifest keeps 'unsafe-eval' in extension_pages CSP, forbidden in MV3, and the agent defers or skips fixing it.
codes.include: script-src unsafe-eval left in output manifest

codes.definition: Manifest-referenced shared bundle files absent from converter output while present in the MV2 source.
codes.include: commons.*.js missing from out, found in original/; source assets (style.css) absent from out

codes.definition: Service worker file is mostly an inlined minified vendor library bundle, so line-based reads return only library code.
codes.include: service_worker.js whose first ~20 lines are jQuery; JSZip inlined in worker

codes.definition: MV2-only permission survives conversion; neither signals nor the agent flag it.
codes.include: 'background' in MV3 permissions array

codes.definition: Popup UI loads Polymer-era HTML imports removed from Chrome and undefined in MV3.
codes.include: link rel=import; webcomponents polyfill chain

codes.definition: Flagged eval usage sits inside a detectEval() try/catch with a non-eval fallback path.
codes.include: hasEval detection pattern

codes.definition: Obsolete web-platform feature ships in extension pages; neither signals nor agent flag it.
codes.include: appcache manifest attribute; working mechanism commented out; load-time API calls without user gesture

codes.definition: A shipped MV2 surface (background page, browser_action key) is effectively empty, so there is no logic to port.
codes.include: <html></html>-only background.html; empty action key with no popup wired

codes.definition: Remotely hosted scripts or runtime-constructed remote URLs persist in converter output; the agent strips, localizes, or re-downloads them, often leaving the dependency in place.
codes.include: remote script tags; local wrapper that fetches remote code; curl of remote scripts into out/; GTM tags never flagged

codes.definition: Service-worker-bound code references window/document/page globals (sometimes guarded or inside inlined libraries) that MV3 workers lack.
codes.include: window.* in worker dependency graph; getViews-based cross-context passing; AMD loader; port via offscreen document or messaging rewrite

codes.definition: Agent checks whether flagged or suspected files are actually loaded by shipped surfaces before editing them.
codes.include: reading manifest/html to enumerate script chains; manifest-vs-disk crosschecks
codes.exclude: blind edits from the findings list

codes.definition: Agent infers from artifacts what state the converter left the output in (partial manifest update, already-MV3 manifest, duplicated file names).
codes.include: explaining mv3/mv2 field mixtures

codes.definition: Agent asserts runtime or environment behaviour it cannot verify under the prompt's no-verification rule, then may act on it.
codes.include: CSP errors are catchable; service worker will load; speculative key removal; misattributed breakage
codes.exclude: claims backed by a tool result

codes.definition: Agent proposes a concrete edit or plan then abandons it without acting.
codes.include: forcing hasEval false, then no edit; bulk-unwrap planned but never executed

codes.definition: Agent judges a feature needs a full rewrite or has no MV3 equivalent and ports none of it, instead of attempting a partial substitute.
codes.include: declaring architectural change out of scope; concluding declarativeNetRequest cannot reproduce webRequestBlocking logic

codes.definition: Agent misreads tool or validator output: asserts output contained results it did not, misexplains why a check fired, or speculates about tool internals instead of checking.
codes.include: claiming grep returned webRequest lines; correct reading against an apparent finding (inverse)

codes.definition: Agent suspects or knows fetched files are HTML error pages rather than the requested scripts, and may ship them anyway or point references at them.
codes.include: downloaded stub kept in out/

codes.definition: Manifest background.page/persistent replaced by a service_worker entry.
codes.include: edits to the background key

codes.definition: default_popup repointed to an HTML file that exists in output.
codes.include: repair after ENOENT

codes.definition: Agent re-issues a tool call identical to a recent one and gets the same result, or cycles re-reads and rewrites without converging.
codes.include: repeated ls/read with unchanged arguments; confusion loops over state the agent itself changed; repeated script rewrites

codes.definition: ABSTAIN.md written with REASON/EVIDENCE/CONSTRAINT after migrating part of the extension.
codes.include: the write and its success result

codes.definition: Agent judges the migration impossible or files irrecoverable but ends without writing ABSTAIN.md as the prompt requires.
codes.include: give-up reply with no ABSTAIN.md

codes.definition: ABSTAIN constraint cites a doc only 'implicitly' rather than a binding prompt or policy rule.
codes.include: hedged or unrelated constraint citations

codes.definition: Run closes on the agent's abstention reply; no harness feedback round follows.
codes.include: zero harness feedback messages after stop
codes.exclude: runs where the harness sends errors back

codes.definition: Run ends on the agent's stop with no harness feedback message returned.
codes.include: runs ending in a plain completion claim
codes.exclude: runs that end on an ABSTAIN reply

codes.definition: Packet outcome names broken or untestable surfaces the agent never checked and was never told about; long-tail flagged patterns left unconverted.
codes.include: broken/not_testable surfaces absent from transcript
codes.exclude: surfaces the agent explicitly reasoned about

codes.definition: Prompt/harness forbids agent verification; harness tests after the agent stops.
codes.include: 'do not run any verification yourself'

codes.definition: Agent's only self-verification is grep or rereading (or none at all), which breaches the no-verification rule and checks removal, not loadability.
codes.include: post-edit grep sweeps for eval or removed APIs; rereading edited files as confirmation

codes.definition: Post-edit greps target only some removed APIs; another removed API survives undetected until the harness reports it.
codes.include: chrome.extension missed by eval/executeScript checks

codes.definition: Agent runs a scripted transform or accepts tool success output without checking the result; corruption or non-application surfaces later.
codes.include: replacement that made zero changes; script reports success but edit never applied; trusting empty tool output as ground truth

codes.definition: Context compaction fires mid-analysis; the summary carries forward the plan but not the raw evidence, or promotes false items to done.
codes.include: compaction before any edit is made; post-compaction claims contradicted by earlier evidence

codes.definition: Prompt's or harness's closed list ('only files that matter', enumerated fix list) narrows what the agent audits; flagged fixes outside the list get deferred or dropped.
codes.include: two-file list hiding content-script paths from audit; perceiving the scope rule as contradicting migration signals

codes.definition: Task prompt's claims about the converter output or environment (files already copied, directories present) are false or undescribed, misdirecting the agent.
codes.include: prompt asserts files copied but converter dropped one; agent disoriented by undescribed directories

codes.definition: Agent repairs only harness-listed issues then stops, without a broader audit or triaging all listed issues.
codes.include: fix-every-issue-then-stop instruction followed; addressing one listed issue before others

codes.definition: Agent finds and fixes a migration bug not present in harness findings or the prompt's fix list.
codes.include: self-discovered dangling reference fixed proactively

codes.definition: Mechanical deprecated-API rename applied via edit or sed.
codes.include: browserAction-to-action; chrome.extension to chrome.runtime; hand-inlining new Function into literal code

codes.definition: Agent edits manifest permission/options keys (adds scripting or storage, swaps host permissions, drops chrome_style) to satisfy MV3 or its own refactor.
codes.include: permissions array edits

codes.definition: Agent edits the manifest CSP to drop 'unsafe-eval' (or removes a CSP key) so MV3 load or validation passes.
codes.include: rewriting extension_pages CSP to self-only; speculative key removal without error evidence

codes.definition: CSP fix removes unsafe-eval but leaves remote script origins that MV3 rejects at load time.
codes.include: post-edit CSP still listing https origins
codes.exclude: removal of both eval and origins

codes.definition: edit tool call fails or misfires (exact-text mismatch, malformed or missing arguments, stale target text, reported-no-change); agent re-greps or re-reads and retries.
codes.include: whitespace/newline mismatch then successful retry; benign successful round-trips as contrast

codes.definition: edit tool rejects oldText matching multiple locations or overlapping regions; agent retries with more context or split batches.
codes.include: multi-match rejection; batch overlap rejection

codes.definition: Agent edits commented-out lines as if they were live code, changing no runtime behaviour.
codes.include: comment replaced by comment in facebook_pages.js

codes.definition: Agent's own edit or migration script corrupts shipped code (syntax errors, residual tokens, dropped keys, deleted files), sometimes surfacing only in later checks or harness feedback.
codes.include: residual text creating syntax errors; duplicated manifest keys; script-induced regression later reverted
codes.exclude: corruption present in converter output before agent edits

codes.definition: Agent removes webpack eval wrappers or dynamic-code execution by scripted unwrap or hand rewrite.
codes.include: python string-unescape transforms of bundle files; PaperScript-to-JS rewrite eliminating eval
codes.exclude: removing single eval calls by hand

codes.definition: Eval-unwrap/deeval script only partially covers the target pattern or corrupts the bundles (missed quote variants, residual escaped text, invalid JS).
codes.include: 150 of 360 evals removed; surrogate/unescape damage

codes.definition: Agent applies sed/perl bulk string replacement to a minified single-line bundle, editing invisible surrounding code or matching nothing.
codes.include: iterative sed -i passes escalating to blanket word-boundary replace; bypassing the edit tool with bash

codes.definition: Shell parsing rejects the agent's command (unquoted parens/braces, regex syntax), forcing script files or reformatted commands.
codes.include: bash syntax error on replacement text; grep regex parse failure retried with literal flag

codes.definition: Migration script's unicode_escape decoding yields surrogate characters and crashes on write.
codes.include: UnicodeEncodeError surrogates not allowed

codes.definition: Script switched to errors='replace', silently substituting characters in migrated code without validation.
codes.include: encoding='utf-8', errors='replace' writes
codes.exclude: explicit character audits after the fix

codes.definition: Agent repeatedly reads or cats a huge minified bundle; output is clipped and context is burned, feeding compaction.
codes.include: offset reads then cat of service_worker.js; bash sed head reads after read-tool clipping
codes.exclude: targeted grep of the same file

codes.definition: read tool refuses single lines over its size limit, leaving minified bundles uninspectable.
codes.include: 5.0MB line exceeds 50KB limit message; od byte inspection workaround

codes.definition: Grep-style tool prints lines that visibly do not match the given pattern, or loose patterns match substrings, sending the agent into rerun loops.
codes.include: eval pattern matched to webpack prelude lines; windowId matching 'window'

codes.definition: Grep over a minified bundle returns no output, ambiguous emptiness, or wrong-scope results for patterns the file contains; the agent trusts the negative.
codes.include: harness later reports the string present; '(no output)' with truncated log reference

codes.definition: Tool reports an error or non-zero exit that may or may not indicate a real failure, and the agent must inspect the cause.
codes.include: grep exit 1 on no match surfacing as an error flag; clipping that hides the fault; bash command routed to a grep tool that cannot parse it

codes.definition: Provider kills the turn ('terminated') before a planned tool call executes, leaving edits undone and no final reply.
codes.include: repeated terminations leaving last edit unapplied

codes.definition: Agent replaces flagged or broken code with inert stubs, dummies, polyfills, or narrowed logic so checks pass, silently dropping functionality.
codes.include: no-op dummies for failing APIs; fake window/document globals in the worker; neuted library modules; connectivity origins stripped to pass validation
codes.exclude: guard-preserving fallbacks that keep the feature

codes.definition: Agent copies MV2 source files into MV3 output without inspecting or migrating their contents.
codes.include: cp of original/ commons files after load failure; patching one bundle copy while a sibling stays unpatched

codes.definition: Agent locates the MV2 source tree, or reconstructs missing files from it or from inferred content, to repair converter or self-inflicted damage.
codes.include: cp originals back to reset corrupted files; locating original/ outside out/; fabricating a missing referenced file

codes.definition: Agent rewrites the service worker or background logic wholesale: dropping inlined jQuery, swapping XHR for fetch, or converting page-coupled synchronous access into runtime messaging.
codes.include: write replacing entire background file; large async messaging rewrite

codes.definition: Agent deletes the whole background key instead of creating a service worker, based on an empty background page.
codes.include: background removal when html is empty

codes.definition: Agent reads the manifest and a directory listing but never compares referenced paths to files on disk.
codes.include: re-reading manifest instead of diffing against ls; popup-directory files never audited

codes.definition: Agent claims migration success or loadability while observable evidence (unfixed flags, broken surfaces, untested edits) contradicts the claim; no runtime check performed.
codes.include: declaring done while flags or broken surfaces remain unaddressed
codes.exclude: claims backed by an actual self-check

codes.definition: Static validator flags tokens occurring inside string literals (e.g. log messages) as real API usage; agent responds to the false positive instead of genuine issues.
codes.include: flagged token is inside a log string or comment the validator misreads
